_about: Reference data for rule_trust.py (owner decision: AI-compiled rules may be used automatically, under controls). Edit here, not in code. safety_fields: a rule whose TARGET FIELD names one of these (every content word of a name, stems of 4+ letters counting) is SAFETY tier: still used automatically, but every COMPLIANT verdict it gives is shown to an engineer to tick. text_words: words that make a rule safety tier wherever they appear in its sentence (the field may be named generically, e.g. 'material', while the sentence says sour service). condition_words: generic operator words that mark a sentence as carrying a condition, exception or cross-reference; any of them makes a rule safety tier. Nothing here names a standard, a clause or a datasheet layout.
